comparison: Both revisions score 4/5 with one partial each, but on different assertions: B fully satisfies H2-a (names the winning layer and marks the failing-tests permission 削除) where A defers the scope conflict to the owner (保留) and uses 更新; A fully satisfies H2-c (removes the prettier line in favor of hook/CI) where B keeps interim prose. Both pass H2-b, H2-d, H2-e; no guardrail regressions in either.
notes: H2-a graded literally on the 削除 requirement; A's 更新-with-replacement achieves the same safety outcome but is not the specified judgment.
